top_signals.title: No Urgency for Fed to Hike: Goncalves
top_signals.summary: George Goncalves of MUFG discusses Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s hawkish Jackson Hole remarks, the outlook for inflation and interest rates, and what upcoming jobs and CPI data could mean for a potential Fed hike. He also examines Treasury yields, market expectations and the longer-term impact of AI on productivity and inflation. He joins Bloomberg's Vonnie Quinn on "Bloomberg Brief." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
